overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the notice identified each property by address and the proposed action, meeting the minimum specificity standard, though including the proposed school would have been helpful.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the December 9, 2015 notice was too vague because it did not say the applicant planned to build a school on the property.
allegations.key_passage: We find that the December 9, 2015 meeting notice met the minimum standards required by the Open Meeting Law.
